title: Task-Centric Multimodal Learning for Cognitive Impairment Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.20906v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dementia affects millions of older adults worldwide, yet early detection remains difficult outside clinical settings. Traditional models primarily rely on text or voice-based responses, capturing only a limited view of human cognition despite the inherently multimodal nature of human expression. This work proposes a contactless, multimodal screening framework that leverages video, audio, and text signals collected during structured voice-based interactions with Amazon Alexa. By incorporating these modalities, our approach captures a more holistic representation of human behavior encompassing speech patterns, vocal characteristics, facial expressions, and linguistic structure, which may enable more accurate detection of cognitive decline. translated_title: 以任务为中心的多模态学习用于认知障碍检测
translated_abstract: 痴呆症影响着全球数百万老年人，但在临床环境之外进行早期检测仍然十分困难。传统模型主要依赖文本或语音响应，尽管人类表达本质上具有多模态特性，它们却只能捕捉到人类认知的有限视角。本工作提出了一种非接触式的多模态筛查框架，利用在与Amazon Alexa进行结构化语音交互过程中收集的视频、音频和文本信号。通过整合这些模态，我们的方法能够捕捉更全面的人类行为表征，涵盖语音模式、声音特征、面部表情和语言结构，从而可能实现更准确的认知衰退检测。不同参与者完成了三项对话任务，这些任务旨在探测自发言语、理解能力和回忆能力。我们追求三个目标：（1）评估三项Alexa任务中的哪一项（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于Amazon Alexa的非接触式多模态筛查框架，融合视频、音频和文本信号，全面捕捉语音模式、面部表情和语言结构等行为特征，以更准确地检测老年人的认知衰退。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a contactless multimodal screening framework leveraging Amazon Alexa that integrates video, audio, and text signals to capture holistic behavioral representations for more accurate detection of cognitive decline.
